description: Animation tables of the story characters in the cutscenes of map7_s03 (Nowhere - final boss). A cutscene asks whether a character's animation is done ("playback") and which keyframe it starts at ("start_keyframe"; the same tables as playback when absent); the answer comes from the table named here, a file gamedata/tables/anim/<table>.json indexed by the character's animation status. "tables" maps a character name to its table and "fallback" is the table of every character not listed (none: such a character has no table). On this map, playback: Cybil uses "cybil", EndingCybil uses "cybil", Dahlia uses "dahlia", EndingDahlia uses "dahlia", Alessa uses "alessa", Kaufmann uses "kaufmann", EndingKaufmann uses "kaufmann", Lisa uses "bloody_lisa", Incubator uses "incubator", BloodyIncubator uses "bloody_incubator" and other characters have no table. Start keyframe: Cybil uses "cybil", EndingCybil uses "cybil", Dahlia uses "dahlia", EndingDahlia uses "dahlia", Alessa uses "alessa", Kaufmann uses "kaufmann", EndingKaufmann uses "kaufmann", BloodyLisa uses "bloody_lisa", Incubator uses "incubator", BloodyIncubator uses "bloody_incubator" and other characters have no table. Lisa's status indexes Bloody Lisa's table in the done/not-done query, Bloody Lisa's own in the first-keyframe query, as in the original. "cue_sounds" sets the volume (0..255) of sounds (names of gamedata/sounds) that an animation keyframe cues: cybil_cue_5, dahlia_cue and dahlia_cue_2 at 32; cybil_handgun_shot at 192; any other cued sound plays at 128. Read when the map loads.
